dataset: SOHO/LASCO CDAW CME Catalog digital height-time measurements
measurement_type: manually selected fastest leading-edge height in the plane of sky
license_note: NASA scientific data; cite the CDAW Data Center and original LASCO instrument team
selection: Six quality-index-5 halo events spanning 2013, 2014, and 2017; exact filenames, sizes, and SHA-256 values are frozen in download_data.py.
retrieval: Run python3 download_data.py; raw YHT files are ignored by source control.
